| # UDS specifications {#uds-specifications-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                            |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The following specifications have been taken into account for the implementation of the UDS communication stack.

- ISO 14229-1 - Specification and requirements

- ISO 14229-3 - Unified diagnostic services on CAN implementation

- ISO 15765-2 - Transport protocol and network layer services
